Johnson Touts GOP Tax Cuts
On Tuesday, Johnson made the argument in an
X
post while sharing a clip of his speech, saying, "If you want more money in your pockets, you have to keep Republicans in charge. We’ve DELIVERED — not just rhetoric, but a record"
He warned that Democrats would "grow big government, raise your taxes again, abolish the borders, abolish prisons, abolish national defense, and take away your freedom, opportunity, and security."
Johnson Warns of Bigger Government
In the video, Johnson pointed to the Working Families Tax Cut and the One Big Beautiful Bill, saying they had put more money in Americans’ pockets.
He said the average Louisiana taxpayer had $2,915 more because of Republican policies and claimed that average take-home pay had increased by about $8,000 per filer.
"We cut taxes, we cut regulations, we limited the size of government," the House Speaker said, adding that 1 million new jobs had been created.
Johnson also pointed to New York Mayor
Zohran Mamdani
as an example of Democratic efforts to expand government.
"What happens when you grow government? You have to tax more and they take more of your hard-earned resources," he said.
He argued that socialism, communism and Marxism have historically produced "human suffering, famine, poverty" and death.
